description:
A type attribute reads to the end of its expression, not to the end of its line. Today line_token_range stops a @spec/@type at the line end, so an @spec whose '::' return continues on the next line does not parse (moved here from fz-sc8.96; library code keeps every @spec on one line because of it). @typep and @opaque are 'unsupported compiler2 attribute head' (reproducer /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/punch/24_opaque_typep.fz). Multi-line specs: punch/30. The OTP json port has 31 @spec, 13 @type, 3 @typep and 1 @opaque, several of them multi-line.

Done when: all of these parse and declare types on all three paths, and the punch/24 and punch/30 reproducers compile. Built after fz-sc8.96 by Elixir Parity.

Part of fz-mue (fz runs OTP's json.erl unchanged). Port and harness: /Users/j5n/Workspace/fz-otp-json/.
title: A type attribute (@type, @typep, @opaque, @spec) reads to the end of its expression
